details.publicNotes:
Whether to the songs of creation or the music in their minds, alvaleks are eternally dancing. These whimsical, flower-like creatures love nothing more than to share their endless dance with others. Unfortunately for their would-be partners, these fey have no concept of fear nor of the pain their thorn-covered bodies can inflict on others. They continue to dance gleefully even long after their companion's cries of pain fall silent.

Alvaleks are frequently found in even-numbered troupes dancing through fields of flowers and forest clearings. Seeing their dance can be entrancing for those who wander too close, luring in the passerby who doesn't realize their peril until it's too late. When found in isolation, they are known to pursue any humanoid that crosses their path.

The only way to safely cross paths with an alvalek is to be already engaged in a dance with a partner. Even when alone, an alvalek is unwilling or unable to intrude upon a performance in progress and will instead seek a partner elsewhere.

Odd One Out

When found in odd-numbered groups, alvaleks are a threat to anyone they see. A lone, unpaired alvalek is always desperate for a partner, while the rest of the troupe, pitying their solitary state, will do anything they can to find them a match—except give up their partner. To help this lone alvalek, pairs of alvaleks surround non-dancing travelers in a swirling ring of dancers, interposing their bodies and using their piercing songs to prevent escape and forcing a coupling.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 12/27/50 gp

Eligible Refinements weapons (piercing), armor(light, medium), shield, skill items (Acrobatics, Athletics, Diplomacy, Nature, Performance)

Eligible Imbued Properties bane, charisma, dexterity, energy resistant (vitality), mind, mind shield, music, sensory (low-light vision), spells (Primal: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{Charm}), sturdy, tangle shield, throwing, time, wild, wood

Trigger The creature with the lowest initiative ends their turn

Effect As the alvalek's internal music reaches a crescendo, the alvalek sings an ear-piercing high note, creating a shockwave that deals @Damage[2d6[sonic]] damage to all non-alvalek creatures within 10 feet. Each creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] save. If a creature is in the area of two or more Fortissimos, they attempt a single save with a –2 circumstance penalty.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is deafened for 1 minute and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

The alvalek dances forth to a song only they can hear and Steps up to 10 feet. If they have a creature @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, they violently reposition that creature to another space in their reach with a dancing flourish, dealing the creature @Damage[5[piercing]] damage.

Requirements The alvalek has a creature @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}

Effect The alvalek taps their foot to a new rhythm, attempting to slow down or speed up the tempo. The grabbed creature can attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save to negate the effect. If the save fails, the alvalek and the grabbed creature become either @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} as time flows with the new tune; the extra action from quickened can only be used to Step or use Leading Step. The change in tempo persists until the grabbed condition ends or the alvalek uses Shifting Tempo again.

An alvalek is not @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} when @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by another creature of Medium size or smaller. They can treat the grabbing creature as being grabbed by them for the purposes of meeting the requirements for Leading Step and Shifting Tempo. An alvalek's nature forbids them from interrupting an ongoing dance; they can't attempt to Grab a creature that is already grappled.

To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.
